description: The brand's Mailchimp CAMPAIGNS, newest first: title, status (save = draft, schedule, sending, sent, paused), subject, preview text, sender, audience and segment, recipient count, send time. Filter by status or audienceId; or pass campaignId to read ONE with Mailchimp's own send checklist (is it ready, and what is missing). For opens, clicks and revenue use mailchimp_report. Read-only, free. Needs Mailchimp connected (Settings > Connectors > Mailchimp, or connect_connector with an API key).
name: list_mailchimp_campaigns
title: List Mailchimp campaigns
